_comment: Benchmark index. The unit is the TASK — one Lean statement whose proof is `sorry` and must be synthesised — and each task lists the Nielsen & Chuang item(s) it answers. A declaration answering two items is one task, not two: a solver proves it once. Locate a task by DECLARATION NAME; positions are not recorded. Dependencies between tasks are in `bench/task-dependencies.csv`, not here.
